responsibility: This file implements GCC’s standalone libdiagnostics library behind the pure C API in `libdiagnostics.h`. It bridges external clients onto GCC’s internal diagnostic subsystem by defining the opaque C-facing objects for files, physical and logical locations, managers, sinks, diagnostics, and execution paths; mapping external logical-location kinds and locations to GCC internal representations; configuring text and SARIF-capable diagnostic contexts and source-printing behavior; validating manager-owned location objects; applying metadata such as CWE, rules, labels, fix-it hints, and path events; and finally emitting completed diagnostics through the manager’s sinks using GCC’s formatting machinery.
same_name_distinction: Implements the C API declared in libdiagnostics.h: it defines the opaque struct layouts and C++ sink/manager machinery behind the API, translates C-facing locations and logical-location kinds into GCC internal diagnostic objects, and performs actual emission to text/SARIF sinks.
